patch_description: Add a compact reciprocal-link coupling for each unordered node pair. The existing linear terms value each direction separately, but do not express the joint benefit when both directions of a substantial bidirectional demand can be served directly. A small negative coupling, capped by the weaker direction’s normalized demand, rewards that combination without letting a one-way-heavy pair dominate. This adds at most n(n−1)/2 terms and leaves the degree penalty and existing route terms unchanged.
